name: agentcode
description: Agentic AI coding assistant — Claude, GPT, Gemini, inline completions, cost-aware routing, open source

agentcode.anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key (sk-ant-...). Falls back to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the workspace .env file or environment.

agentcode.azureApiKey.description: Azure OpenAI API key. Falls back to AZURE_API_KEY in the workspace .env file or environment.

agentcode.azureEndpoint.description: Azure OpenAI endpoint URL (e.g. https://my-resource.openai.azure.com). Falls back to AZURE_API_BASE in .env or environment.

agentcode.openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key (sk-...). Falls back to OPENAI_API_KEY in the workspace .env file or environment.

agentcode.geminiApiKey.description: Google Gemini API key. Falls back to GEMINI_API_KEY in the workspace .env file or environment.

agentcode.model.description: Default LLM model (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-4o, gemini/gemini-2.5-pro)

agentcode.executablePath.description: Path to the agentcode executable (default: agentcode from PATH)

agentcode.inlineCompletions.enabled.description: Enable inline code completions powered by Claude Haiku (requires Anthropic API key)
